LESSON: USES OF WATER

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3.2: Uses of water

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Uses of water. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate careful use of water from the stimulus materials in the home and school  Learners to discuss careful use of water

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: USES OF WATER
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Uses of water helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS ABOUT WATER
We use water for drinking, cooking, cleaning, and farming.
Conserve water: close taps, fix leaks, reuse grey water for plants where safe.
Unsafe water can cause disease — store drinking water in clean covered containers.

PART 1: Demonstrate careful use of water from the stimulus materials in the home and school  Learners to discuss careful use of water

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate careful use of water from the stimulus materials in the home and school  Learners to discuss careful use of water. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate careful use of water from the stimulus materials in the home and school  Learners to discuss careful use of water.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Uses of water” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate careful use of water from the stimulus materials in the home and school  Learners to discuss careful use of water. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Uses of water is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Conserve water: close taps, fix leaks, reuse grey water for plants where safe.

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Uses of water” around your school. (skill: demonstrate careful use of water from the stimulus materials in the home and school  Learners to discuss careful use of water)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Uses of water to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: demonstrate careful use of water from the stimulus materials in the home and school  Learners to discuss careful use of water.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Uses of water from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Uses of water: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Uses of water?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Uses of water means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: demonstrate careful use of water from the stimulus materials in the home and school  Learners to discuss careful use of water.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
